subject: Renewal planning - forward hedge credit structure to stabilize unit pricing
messages:
From: Ella Park <ella@cloudpartners.io>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal/terms — request to lock pricing with multi-year prepay

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last month. We're planning our 2027 budget and want to lock predictable unit economics for the next 24 months. Our procurement lead asked whether Redwood can offer a multi-year prepay structure that:

- Locks current per-token/embedding unit rates for the first 18 months
- Provides a forward credit ladder to offset the expected rate step in month 19–24 rather than a straight list price increase
- Includes a staged ramp so we don't overcommit in months 1–6

Can you share a sample term sheet and a simple credit schedule showing how this would look at 2x and 3x committed usage tiers? Also note we need basic SOC2 attestation details attached to the commercial proposal.

For context, our estimated baseline is ~5M tokens/month today, with burst patterns up to 20M in Q4. We'd like to avoid a material price increase mid-contract.

If you can send a proposal this week, procurement can review on Monday (May 11).

Thanks,
Ella Park
Sr. Procurement Manager
NexGen Media
ella@cloudpartners.io
(415) 555-0198

-- attachment stub: NexGen_Procurement_Specs.pdf (pdf, 128KB)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal/terms — request to lock pricing with multi-year prepay

Hi Ella — appreciate the details and the timeline.

We can definitely structure a multi-year prepay that accomplishes the goals you listed. High-level proposal (see attached stub term sheet):

- Term: 24 months with optional 12-month extension
- Pricing hold: current unit rates guaranteed through month 18
- Forward credit ladder: prepaid credits released monthly to offset month 19–24 step increases (credits scale with committed tier)
- Ramp schedule: 3-month ramp (25% baseline month 1, 60% month 2, 100% month 3) with credit banking within year 1 for burst months
- Breakage/true-up: quarterly true-up against committed units with rolling credit adjustments; unused credits may be carried into year 2 subject to a 10% cap

Attached: Redwood_sample_term_sheet_v1.pdf (term sheet stub) and a one-sheet credit schedule example.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal review by our finance/legal (Monica + Marissa will lead).
2) We produce a binding commercial term sheet and send for NexGen procurement review by Tue EOD.
3) If the commercial terms look good, we draft PO and DocuSign paperwork.

Are there any regulatory or billing constraints from your side (PO timelines, invoicing cadence)?

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive — Enterprise| Redwood Inference

Thanks Dylan — this is exactly the direction we were hoping for. A few clarifying items from procurement:

- Can you provide a 12-month monthly breakdown (months 1–24) at the 2x and 3x committed tiers (we want to model cash flow and capex)
- Any minimum notification period for activating the optional 12-month extension?
- SOC2 evidence: a short attestation excerpt would be helpful in the first PDF page (we have a tight review window)

Also, how do credits apply to burst months if we exceed committed monthly capacity? Can credits be automatically consumed and then reconciled at quarter end?

If you can get the 12-month breakdown + SOC2 blurb by EOD Thursday, we can circulate to finance and sign off on an LOI/term sheet next week.

Thanks,
Ella

Subject: Re: Renewal/terms — request to lock pricing with multi-year prepay

Hi Ella — looping in finance to be explicit on the schedule. Monica and I discussed and propose the following commercial mechanics:

Proposed credit and ramp mechanics (compressed):
- Commit tiers (monthly baseline):
  • Tier A: 5M tokens/mo (current baseline) — 2x multiplier pricing bucket
  • Tier B: 10M tokens/mo — 3x multiplier pricing bucket
- Prepay structure: 12-month upfront payment covering months 1–12; optional prepaid top-up for months 13–24 at start of month 13 to preserve flexibility
- Credit ladder for months 19–24: prepaid credits equal to 30% of total committed value, released monthly as credit multipliers; the ladder increases linearly: month19=4%, m20=5%, m21=6%, m22=7%, m23=4%, m24=4% (example)
- Ramp: month1 30% baseline, month2 60%, month3 100% (we can tighten to 25/50/100 if preferred)
- Burst handling: credits auto-consume against overage; quarterly reconciliation true-up with cashback or additional invoice depending on net usage
- Extension notice: 60 days prior to month 25 for optional 12-month extension

Attached is a spreadsheet with the 24-month monthly breakouts at 2x and 3x tiers and a short SOC2 attestation blurb suitable for procurement packet.

If that looks acceptable, we'll convert to a formal term sheet and include PO/invoice language and DocuSign routing.

Action items:
- Ella: confirm Tier choice (A or B) and preferred ramp (30/60/100 vs 25/50/100) by EOD Friday
- Monica: I'll queue up the draft commercial term sheet for legal review Monday

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Americas | Redwood Inference
